rationale: Independent byte-pin, AST and literal-value checks confirm the entire module has the same semantics as the exact R2 source that was applied. The only changes wrap the two overlong ascensor/prăvălie tuple lines and add harmless trailing commas. All 22 aliases, the single bidirectional pedestrian-path synonym edge, empty node/round identities and the proposal match remain exact. The prior independent content quality judgments stand unchanged and their archived source/reviews are preserved. This authoring-module formatting is outside the native runtime hash inventory; the three fresh installed audit acceptances remain bound to their checked runtime/source bytes.
